Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_desc VARCHAR2(50);
 -- get the outdate products
 cursor c1 is
 select product_type, blood_type, count(unit_id) qty
 from active_products a
 where exp_date <= :s_out_date
 and a.stock_state = 'AV'
 and a.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and a.inventory_class like nvl(:s_inventory_class,'%')
 and warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse
 group by product_type, blood_type;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 -- determine if there are any out of date products
 select count(unit_id) into :GLOBAL.count
 from active_products
 where stock_state = 'AV'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inventory_class like nvl(:s_inventory_class,'%')
 and warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse
 and exp_date <= :s_out_date;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1.s_out_date');
 show_error_dist('5400'); -- no units are out of date
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 -- are there any out of date units
 if :GLOBAL.count > 0
 then
 -- yes
 :system.message_level := '10';
 :ctrl_blk_1.total_outdates := :GLOBAL.count;
 go_block('inventory_levels');
 -- store them in the inventory levels block by product type
 -- and blood type
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :inventory_levels.product_type := c1_rec.product_type;
 :inventory_levels.blood_type := c1_rec.blood_type;
 :inventory_levels.s_qty := c1_rec.qty;
 get_blood_type_desc(:inventory_levels.blood_type,temp_desc);
 :inventory_levels.s_aborh := temp_desc;
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
 go_query('ac_products');
 go_block('inventory_levels');
 go_record('1');
 make_bold;
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW'
 then
 null;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 check_package_failure;
 else
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.s_out_date');
 show_error_dist('5400'); -- no units are out of date
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_PICK_SLIP_PRODUCTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_pick_slip_products is
 t_count Number;
 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id, product_code, exp_date,
 blood_type, product_type, aliquot, coll_date
 from active_products
 where exp_date <= :s_out_date
 and stock_state = 'AV'
 and inventory_class like nvl(:s_inventory_class,'%')
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse;
 begin
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 select count(*) into t_count 
 from quarantine_products
 where unit_id = c1rec.unit_id --Already exists in quarantine Products ?
 and product_code = c1rec.product_code
 and aliquot = c1rec.aliquot;
 if t_count <= 0 then
 insert into pick_slip_products
 (pick_slip_id,chapter_id,unit_id,product_code,
 exp_date,blood_type,product_type,
 product_status,aliquot,coll_date,
 program_id)
 values(:s_pick_slip_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id,c1rec.unit_id,
 c1rec.product_code,c1rec.exp_date,c1rec.blood_type,
 c1rec.product_type,:g_product_status,c1rec.aliquot,
 c1rec.coll_date,:prog_name);
 end if;
 end loop;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure gen_report(program_name in VARCHAR2,
 id in VARCHAR2) is
 temp_count NUMBER;
 temp_parm VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_parm2 varchar2(5) := null;
 temp_printer VARCHAR2(10);
 usr_id varchar2(15) := name_in('banner.user_id'); 
 s_print_id varchar2(80);
 chap_id varchar2(15) := name_in('global.chapter_id');
 id2 varchar2(15);
 temp_mode varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 temp_parm := 'PIKID';
 temp_count := 0;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from rpt_parm
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = usr_id and
 report_name = program_name and
 parm_id = id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 If temp_count = 0 then
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,
 parm_date,submit_date,report_status)
 values
 ('DON',usr_id,program_name,
 id,sysdate,sysdate,'E');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 Else
 begin
 delete from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = usr_id and
 report_name = program_name and
 parm_id = id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 End if;
 
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',usr_id,program_name,
 id, 1, chap_id, 'CHP');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',usr_id,program_name,
 id, 2, id, temp_parm);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',usr_id,program_name,
 id, 3, :GLOBAL.warehouse, 'WH');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;


 copy('5','system.message_level');
 commit;
 copy('0','system.message_level');
 
 REPORT_GENERATE(lower(program_name),id);
 
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000'); /* transaction committed */
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error_dist('0600'); /* unsuccessful commit */
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: REPORT_GENERATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE(pl_rep_name in varchar2, pl_parm_id in varchar2) IS
parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;

 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 
--for Apps server -- 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);

 -- Multiple reports server changes;
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(70);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 --message('number -1');
 
/* Get the report server name from the master code table*/

 When no_data_found then

 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
*/


 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');

 END IF;
 ------------
--message('number -2');

--val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
--filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;

filename:=pl_rep_name||'_'||pl_parm_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(pl_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);

SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);

Message('Outdated Slip Report submitted ..', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);

WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
LOOP
vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
END LOOP;

--message('number -3');

IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN

 where user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and lower(report_name) = lower(pl_rep_name)
 and parm_id=pl_parm_id;
 
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
 message('Outdated Slip generated');
ELSE
message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
END IF;
*/

:system.message_level:=15;
commit; 
:system.message_level:=0;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :g_allow_commit = 'Y'
 then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 -- update pick slips
 create_pick_slip_id;
 create_order_no;
 message('Msg: Please note the new pick slip ID.', NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); -- IM 476
 --pause; -- IM 476
 insert_pick_slips;
 -- update pick slip products table insert products
 insert_pick_slip_products;
 
 -- update active products table set stock state 'OD' outdate
 update_active_products;
 
 -- print pick slip, commit is done within the pick slip printing
 
 gen_report(:g_report_name,:ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id);
 :g_allow_commit := 'N';
 else
 show_error_dist('0200');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 pause;
 end;

 end if;
end;
